user.title: ThermoWorks Cloud API key
user.description: Create an API key in the ThermoWorks Cloud web app ({integrations_url}) under Account → Integrations. You can limit it to the devices this Home Assistant should see. The key is shown once. API docs: {docs_url}

reauth_confirm.title: ThermoWorks Cloud needs an API key
reauth_confirm.description: ThermoWorks Cloud no longer accepts email and password sign-in for home automation, or the saved API key was revoked or expired. Create an API key in the ThermoWorks Cloud web app ({integrations_url}) under Account → Integrations and enter it here. Your devices and entities are kept.

error.rate_limited: ThermoWorks Cloud rate limit reached for this key. Wait a minute and try again.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll for updates
